GEODZ 511: Students study the theory and principles of geospatially-based design by investigating the methods and collaborative nature of the geodesign process.
GEODZ 596A: Preparation and peer-review presentation of proposal for an individual capstone geodesign project.
GEODZ 596B: Preparation and dissemination of geodesign capstone project results in a formal professional venue.
GEODZ 822: The principles, inherent values and practical applications of Evaluation and Decision models as implemented within the Geodesign Framework.
GEODZ 824: The principles, inherent values and practical applications of Process and Impact models as implemented within the Geodesign Framework.
GEODZ 826: The principles, inherent values and practical applications of Representation and Change models as implemented within the Geodesign Framework.
